dedupe_keys.name: achieving 19 efficiency in nonfused ring electron acceptor solar cells via solubility control of donor and acceptor crystallisation

description: Achieving 19% efficiency in nonfused ring electron acceptor solar cells via solubility control of donor and acceptor crystallisation is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Materials Cloud. Nonfused ring electron acceptors (NFREAs) are interesting n-type near infrared (NIR) photoactive semiconductors with strong molecular absorption and easy synthetic route. However, the low backbone planarity and bulky substitution make NFREA less crystalline, which significantly retards charge transport and the formation of bicontinuous morphology in organic photovoltaic device. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Materials Cloud. The portal shows 2026-09-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
